title: Pux
description: CLI tool that watches your CI, extracts failure context, and auto-injects it into your AI coding agent.
details: Built a real-time GitHub Actions monitor with an ambient terminal companion. Automatically downloads logs, extracts stacktraces, grabs diffs, and writes structured context to .ai-context/failure.md for seamless AI agent integration.
problem: Developers waste 25+ minutes per CI failure opening GitHub, scrolling logs, and copy-pasting errors into AI assistants.
solution: Built a CLI that polls GitHub Actions, pulls failure logs, extracts the relevant error window, and writes structured context directly into AI agent config files.
impact: Zero-tab, zero-copy-paste CI debugging workflow. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Codex, Gemini, Windsurf, and Cline.

title: PortWatch
description: High-performance observability tool for Linux developers with zero-noise filtering.
details: Built with Go and React. Features deep-packet inspection, Docker native identification, and instant kill control. Native support for IPv6 and container protocols.
problem: Linux port monitoring is often noisy and lacks Docker-native context.
solution: Implemented heuristic filters and deep-packet inspection for unified, noise-free monitoring.
impact: Reduced debugging time for network services by providing instant, relevant telemetry.

title: Neurobase
description: AI-powered developer tool to query PostgreSQL and MongoDB in natural language.
details: Built modular agent-based architecture with Vercel AI SDK. Supports SQL and NoSQL with query traceability and error feedback.
problem: Developers struggle to query databases using natural language.
solution: Built an AI-powered interface with query traceability and error feedback.
impact: Improved developer efficiency by reducing time spent writing complex queries.
